messages:
Lia: Heads up — I’m seeing a spike in EU aggregate recompute failures after yesterday’s ingest-schema tweak. Console alerting only fired when SRE paged, so operators were already in the weeds. anyone else seeing reprocess errors for eu-agg slices?
Sam: Yup, noticed ~5% fail rate in the batch job metrics this morning. traceback looks like a KV warmup key mismatch (old prefix).
Nina: I grabbed a trace — requests routed to the legacy variant because the rollout policy still lists `model:v2-compat` as compatible for small sequences. Console rollout flags didn’t propagate to dedicated routing.
Arjun: Can we pause the automated backfills for EU until we confirm routing alignment? don’t want to keep burning retries. which API/flag to flip?
Lia: thinking `POST /internal/backfill/control` with body {slice: eu, action: pause} but want ops signoff. ops-bot, can you run a soft pause on eu-replays? :pray:
ops-bot: Received. Suggested operator flow: 1) set backfill.state=PAUSED for slice=eu 2) disable canary routing for model:v2-compat 3) run small dry-run rehydrate. Will wait for human confirm.
Sam: command I’ll run locally to dry-run:
```
replay-cli run --slice eu --start 2026-03-18T00:00Z --end 2026-03-18T06:00Z --mode dry-run --concurrency 2
```
If that passes we can scale up.
Nina: quick log snippet i pulled from failing job:
```
ERROR AggregateRecomputeWorker - shard=eu-12 - kv_lookup failed: KeyError('agg:v1::tenant123')
  at redis_client.get(…)
  at recompute.apply_prefix(…)
```
That `agg:v1` prefix is stale after the schema rename.
Arjun: so root cause: schema rename => kv prefix bump => routing still sending old-rewrite codepath. console rollout UX hid the mismatch. we should add a preflight that checks prefix compatibility before rolling to routing.
Lia: agree — short term: pause EU backfills, remove v2-compat from routing policy for eu, then trigger a small rehydrate dry-run with warmed KV. long term: add compatibility-check step and a console banner for rollout/routing divergence.
Sam: I’ll pause job queue now and run dry-run, ping back in ~15m.
Nina: I’ll open a tiny PR to console that surfaces "routing vs rollout mismatch" under the rollout summary — minimal change, just show current routing table and model compatibility matrix.
Lia: tagging @Arjun to own the compatibility-check RFC. can we add a telemetry metric that counts prefix-mismatches so alerting can catch this before operator pages? :rotating_light:
Arjun: on it — will draft RFC and add a metric `telemetry.kv_prefix_mismatch.count` + console alert rule.
deploy-bot: NOTE: pausing backfills requires approval from two platform leads. Lia and Arjun, please +1 in thread to confirm.
Lia: +1
Arjun: +1
ops-bot: Pause enacted for slice=eu. backfill.state=PAUSED. Canary routing for model:v2-compat disabled for eu region.
Sam: dry-run succeeded for the small window, no kv errors after we warmed the cache. next step: a staggered small-scale rehydrate for 2h window, then expand.
Nina: PR opened: minimal UI banner + link to routing debug page. pls review. https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/4021
Lia: thanks all. follow-ups: Arjun RFC for prefix-check, Nina PR review, Sam to run staged rehydrate, ops to monitor. I’ll add a post-incident note in #incidents after we finish. :white_check_mark:
